rows.grounds: locative of liṅga in the partless-liṅga worship context
compound śiras + māna; subject of passive verb

items.question: Why is head-measurement not obtained in the partless liṅga's worship portion when the head is absent?
items.inference: Without a head in the partless liṅga's worship portion, no head-measurement is obtained.
uncertainties: exact grammatical role of śiromānam in the passive construction
items.plain_english: In the partless liṅga, in the worship portion, head-measurement is not obtained.
